definition_zh: 人际的；人与人之间的；人际交往的
definition_en: existing or happening between people, or concerning the way people deal with one another
core_image: 两个人隔着一张小桌相对而坐，桌上没有文件，只有彼此的语气、眼神和说话之间的停顿
scene: 新主管上任第一周没有急着改流程，而是把每个人的名字、班次和最近家里的难处记进本子，开会前先问一句周末过得怎样。 New managers are often advised to invest in interpersonal skills before they try to change any process.
sceneCN: 这里 interpersonal 指「与人打交道的能力」（第 2 个义项）；句意为：人们常建议新主管先投入人际技能，然后再去改动任何流程。

pos.zh: 人际的；人与人之间的；人际交往的

derivatives.zh: 在人际层面上（由 interpersonal 加副词后缀，把行为限定到人与人之间）
非个人的；没有人情味的（由否定前缀加 personal，把个人因素抽走）
非个人性；冷淡（由否定前缀加 personal 再加名词后缀，指抽掉个人情感后的状态）
个性化（由 personal 加表示过程的名词后缀，把公共的东西调整到某个人身上）

senses.title: Happening between people
senses.definition: existing or taking place between two or more people rather than inside one person
senses.definitionCN: 存在于或发生在两个或更多个人之间，而不是单个人内部
senses.example: The office layout changed the whole interpersonal atmosphere.
senses.exampleCN: 办公室的布局改变了整个人际氛围。
senses.why: The prefix inter- means 'between', so the adjective marks whatever sits in the space that two people share rather than in either head alone.
senses.whyCN: 那个前缀意为「在……之间」，所以这个形容词标记的是两人共享的那片空间里的东西，而不是任何一个人脑中的东西。

senses.title: Skill in handling people
senses.definition: describing the ability to read, respect and manage other people in everyday dealings
senses.definitionCN: 描述在日常交往中读懂、尊重并处理好他人的能力
senses.example: Her interpersonal skills made a difficult client stay with the firm.
senses.exampleCN: 她的人际技巧让一个难缠的客户留在了公司。
senses.why: Once the space between people is recognised, it can be worked on like any other skill: listening, turn-taking and repair after a mistake.
senses.whyCN: 一旦承认两人之间那片空间存在，它就能像别的技能一样被练习：倾听、轮流说话、出错后修补。

senses.title: Friction between people
senses.definition: describing conflict, tension or misunderstanding that arises between people
senses.definitionCN: 描述人与人之间产生的冲突、紧张或误解
senses.example: The project failed not from bad planning but from interpersonal conflict.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目失败的原因不是计划糟糕，而是人际冲突。
senses.why: The same shared space can hold irritation as well as trust; the adjective simply locates the friction between the parties instead of inside one of them.
senses.whyCN: 同一片共享空间既能装信任，也能装恼火；这个形容词只是把摩擦定位在双方之间，而不是某一个人内部。

senses.title: Communication between people
senses.definition: describing the exchange of messages, meaning or feeling between people
senses.definitionCN: 描述人与人之间信息、意义或情感的交换
senses.example: Most of the misunderstanding came from interpersonal communication, not from the data.
senses.exampleCN: 大部分误解来自人际沟通，而不是数据本身。
senses.why: A message must be sent and received; when both ends are people, the channel between them is the thing the adjective describes.
senses.whyCN: 信息要被送出也要被接收；当两端都是人时，这个形容词描述的就是两人之间那条通道。

senses.title: Attraction and closeness
senses.definition: describing the pull of liking, trust or romantic interest that draws people together
senses.definitionCN: 描述把人们拉到一起的喜欢、信任或恋爱兴趣
senses.example: Interpersonal attraction grows when people find their views confirmed.
senses.exampleCN: 当人们发现对方印证了自己的观点时，人际吸引会增强。
senses.why: The line between two people has a direction and a strength; attraction is the force that shortens it, and the adjective names the field in which that force operates.
senses.whyCN: 两人之间那条线有方向也有强度；吸引就是缩短这条线的力，这个形容词命名的是这股力起作用的场域。

senses.title: Distance and personal space
senses.definition: describing how close people stand or sit in relation to one another and how that spacing is read
senses.definitionCN: 描述人们彼此站得多近、坐得多近，以及这种间距如何被解读
senses.example: Interpersonal distance shrinks when two people share a secret.
senses.exampleCN: 当两个人共享一个秘密时，人际距离会缩短。
senses.why: If closeness is a line, it can be measured in centimetres; the adjective applies the same idea to physical spacing and the comfort it signals.
senses.whyCN: 如果亲近是一条线，它就能用厘米来量；这个形容词把同一个观念用到身体间距以及间距所传达的舒适感上。

senses.title: A psychological and therapeutic frame
senses.titleCN: 心理学与治疗中的框架
senses.definition: in psychology, describing a theory or therapy that treats relations with other people as central to mental life
senses.definitionCN: 心理学中描述把与他人的关系视为心理生活核心的理论或疗法
senses.example: Interpersonal therapy treats depression by working on how the patient handles other people.
senses.exampleCN: 人际疗法通过处理患者与他人的相处方式来治疗抑郁。
senses.why: A clinical school can take the between-person space as its unit and build a whole method around repairing it, which turns the adjective into a label for that method.
senses.whyCN: 一个临床学派可以把「人与人之间」当作单位，并围绕修复它建立整套方法；这个形容词于是成了那套方法的标签。

senses.title: Comparison across persons in economics
senses.definition: in economics and philosophy, describing the comparison of welfare, utility or well-being between different people
senses.definitionCN: 经济学与哲学中描述不同人之间福利、效用或幸福感的比较
senses.example: Policy debates often depend on interpersonal comparisons of well-being.
senses.exampleCN: 政策争论常常取决于对人们幸福感的跨人比较。
senses.why: Once well-being is put on one scale, the line between two people becomes a comparison of two readings, and the adjective marks that move across separate persons.
senses.whyCN: 一旦把幸福感放到同一把尺子上，两人之间的线就变成两个读数的比较；这个形容词标记的正是跨越不同个体的那一步。

intro.en: Interpersonal is a modern English compound of inter- 'between' and personal. The prefix is Latin, and personal goes back through Latin personalis to persona, a word whose deeper origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: interpersonal 是近代英语的复合词：表示「在……之间」的前缀加 personal。前缀来自拉丁语，personal 则经拉丁 personalis 追溯到 persona，而 persona 的更早来源不确定。

items.en: Inter was a Latin preposition and prefix meaning 'between, among, during'. English keeps it in international, interact and interpersonal.
items.cn: inter 是拉丁语介词兼前缀，意为「在……之间、在……之中、在……期间」。英语把它保留在 international、interact 与 interpersonal 里。

items.en: Persona first meant a mask worn by an actor and then the role or character played, later a human being. Source uncertain: an Etruscan origin has been proposed, but no single source can be demonstrated.
items.cn: persona 最初指演员戴的面具，随后指所扮演的角色，再后来指人。来源不确定：有伊特鲁里亚来源的假说，但无法证明唯一来源。

items.en: The adjective personalis meant 'of a person, belonging to a person'. It passed into Old French and then into English as personal.
items.cn: 形容词 personalis 意为「人的、属于个人的」，经古法语进入英语，成为 personal。

items.en: English joined the Latin prefix to the borrowed adjective to make interpersonal, generally dated to the nineteenth century and meaning simply 'between persons'.
items.cn: 英语把拉丁前缀加到借来的形容词上，构成 interpersonal，一般认为是十九世纪的产物，字面意思就是「人与人之间的」。

items.en: In the twentieth century psychology and management gave the word its familiar phrases: interpersonal relations, interpersonal skills and interpersonal therapy.
items.cn: 到二十世纪，心理学与管理学给了这个词一批常见搭配：人际关系、人际技能、人际疗法。

items.en: Source uncertain: the chain beyond persona is debated. Competing proposals exist, and none is generally accepted as proven; the word is best treated as having no demonstrated deeper root.
items.cn: 来源不确定：persona 再往前的链条不确定。存在几种互相竞争的假说，没有一种被普遍接受为已证明；最好把这个词当作没有可证实的更深词根。

note.en: The first group separates forms built on the same root with different prefixes or endings; the second compares words that also concern contact between people but from another angle.
note.cn: 第一组分辨同一词根配不同前缀或词尾的形式；第二组比较同样涉及人与人接触、但角度不同的词。

entries.definition: Same personal base with a negative prefix: it means without personal warmth, the reverse of what interpersonal usually praises.
entries.definitionCN: 否定前缀加 personal：把个人因素抽走，指不带人情味的制度或态度。

entries.definition: intra- means 'within', so this word is about what happens inside one person, the opposite side of the same boundary.
entries.definitionCN: 表示「在内」的前缀意为「在……之内」，所以这个词指发生在一个人内部的事，是同一道边界的另一侧。

entries.definition: The base word: it means belonging to one person, while interpersonal requires at least two.
entries.definitionCN: 基础形容词：意为属于某一个人；而 interpersonal 至少需要两个人。

entries.definition: Built on person with -able: it means pleasant and easy to like, not 'between people'.
entries.definitionCN: 由 person 加表示「能……」的形容词后缀构成：意为讨人喜欢、容易相处，而不是「人与人之间的」。

entries.definition: It concerns society, groups and public life; interpersonal is limited to the contact between particular people.
entries.definitionCN: 它涉及社会、群体与公共生活；interpersonal 则限于具体个人之间的接触。

entries.definition: It describes a person's willingness or ability to convey messages; interpersonal describes the space or skill of dealing with people.
entries.definitionCN: 它描述一个人愿意或能够传达信息；interpersonal 描述的是与人相处的空间或能力。

entries.definition: It applies to any kind of link, including data and grammar; interpersonal is the human-only case.
entries.definitionCN: 它适用于任何联结，包括数据与语法；interpersonal 只是其中专指人的那一种。

entries.definition: It stresses action and response between parties, often with machines; interpersonal stresses that both parties are people.
entries.definitionCN: 它强调双方的动作与回应，常涉及机器；interpersonal 强调双方都是人。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: inter- means 'between' and personal means 'of a person': the compound literally places something between persons.
normal.cn: 表示「在……之间」的前缀加 personal「个人的」：这个复合词字面上把东西放在人与人之间。

normal.en: Impersonal is its mirror image: im- negates personal, so the warmth is removed.
normal.cn: impersonal 是它的镜像：否定前缀否定 personal，人情味被抽走。

normal.en: Intrapersonal uses intra- 'within': the same boundary, but looking inward instead of across.
normal.cn: intrapersonal 用表示「在内」的前缀：同一道边界，只是向内看而不是向对面看。

normal.en: Interpersonal skills is the phrase in job advertisements, where technique alone is not enough.
normal.cn: 「人际技能」是招聘广告里的常见说法，光有技术还不够。

normal.en: Interpersonal conflict is the phrase used when the disagreement belongs to the relationship, not to the task.
normal.cn: 「人际冲突」用于分歧属于关系本身、而不属于任务的时候。

abstract.en: Picture a table with two chairs: whatever happens in the air above that table is interpersonal.
abstract.cn: 想象一张桌子配两把椅子：桌子上方那片空气里发生的事，就是人际的。

abstract.en: The air can carry trust, irritation, a joke or a silence; the adjective does not choose which.
abstract.cn: 那片空气能承载信任、恼火、玩笑或沉默；这个形容词并不挑选是哪一种。

abstract.en: Move one chair away and the distance itself becomes a message.
abstract.cn: 把一把椅子挪远，距离本身就成了一条信息。

examples.en: Interpersonal relationships at work affect how quickly problems are reported.
examples.cn: 工作中的人际关系会影响问题被多快上报。

examples.en: The training focused on interpersonal communication rather than on software.
examples.cn: 这次培训侧重人际沟通，而不是软件操作。

examples.en: Interpersonal conflict between the two leads delayed the whole project.
examples.cn: 两位负责人之间的人际冲突拖慢了整个项目。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特怕森诺」听起来像「因他怕生」：因为他一见生人就怕，才更需要练人际交往；记住「怕生」，就记住「人际的」。

root: 由拉丁前缀（意为「在……之间」）加 personal「个人的」构成；personal 经拉丁 personalis 来自 persona「面具、角色」，persona 更深来源不确定，有伊特鲁里亚来源假说，不能定论。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all sit in the space between two people: the space itself, the skill of working in it, its friction, its messages, its pull, its measured width, its clinical method and its use as a scale for comparing welfare.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都落在两个人之间的那片空间里：空间本身、在其中运作的技能、其中的摩擦、其中的信息、其中的拉力、被量出的宽度、围绕它建立的临床方法，以及把它当作比较福利的尺子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shared space between two people, filled by tone, look and pause.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人之间共享的一片空间，被语气、眼神与停顿填满。

branches.en: THE SPACE ITSELF: whatever happens between people rather than inside one of them.
branches.cn: 空间本身：发生在人与人之间、而非某人内部的一切。

branches.en: WORKING IN THE SPACE: the skill of handling people and the messages that pass between them.
branches.cn: 在这片空间里作业：处理他人的技能，以及在两人之间传递的信息。

branches.en: WHEN THE SPACE HEATS UP: friction and misunderstanding located between the parties.
branches.cn: 空间升温时：摩擦与误解被定位在双方之间。

branches.en: FORCE AND MEASURE: attraction shortens the space, distance reports how wide it is.
branches.cn: 拉力与量度：吸引把空间缩短，距离报告它有多宽。

branches.en: FROM SPACE TO METHOD AND SCALE: a therapy built on it, and an economic comparison across persons.
branches.cn: 从空间到方法与尺子：围绕它建立的疗法，以及跨人的经济比较。

intro.en: Interpersonal can be read morpheme by morpheme: a Latin prefix of position, a root for person, an adjective ending, and a compound that puts them together.
intro.cn: interpersonal 可以逐个语素读出来：一个表示位置关系的拉丁前缀、一个表示人的词根、一个形容词词尾，以及把它们拼在一起的复合过程。

latinIntro.en: Latin inter 'between' and persona 'mask, role' combined through the adjective personalis; English then prefixed the borrowed adjective to make the modern word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 inter「在……之间」与 persona「面具、角色」经形容词 personalis 结合；英语再给借来的形容词加上前缀，构成现代这个词。

items.example: The prefix marks a position between two sides.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出位于两侧之间的位置。

items.structure: person (root from Latin persona, mask or role)
items.example: The room held only one person.
items.exampleCN: 房间里只有一个人。

items.example: She kept a personal record of the meetings.
items.exampleCN: 她为这些会议保留了一份私人记录。

items.example: The job requires strong interpersonal judgement.
items.exampleCN: 这份工作需要很强的人际判断力。

items.meaning: to play the role of another person
items.example: He was arrested for impersonating an officer.
items.exampleCN: 他因冒充官员而被捕。

items.meaning: the enduring pattern of a person's character
items.example: Her personality suits front-line work.
items.exampleCN: 她的性格适合做一线工作。

items.meaning: to treat a thing as a person, or to be a perfect example
items.meaningCN: 把事物拟人化；是……的化身
items.example: The old tree personified patience.
items.exampleCN: 那棵老树仿佛是耐心的化身。

items.meaning: the act of adapting something to one person
items.example: Personalization made the service feel less anonymous.
items.exampleCN: 个性化让这项服务少了些冷冰冰的感觉。

latinEntries.structure: Latin noun of uncertain deeper origin
latinEntries.meaning: a mask; a role; a person
latinEntries.meaningCN: 面具；角色；人（更深来源不确定）

latinEntries.meaning: of a person; belonging to a person

derivatives.zh: 在人际层面上（interpersonal 加副词后缀，把行为限定到两人之间）
非个人的（否定前缀加 personal，抽掉个人温度）
非个人性（否定前缀加 personal 再加名词后缀，指冷淡无人的状态）
个性化（personal 加表示过程的名词后缀，把公共事物调到某个人身上）

definition_zh: 遗传漂变；基因漂变（小种群中由抽样误差引起的等位基因频率随机波动）
definition_en: random change in allele frequencies from one generation to the next because only a sample of individuals reproduces
core_image: 一口被岩石围住的小水塘里，几十条鱼各自带着不同的斑纹，几代之后某些斑纹再也找不到
scene: 山谷里那口被岩石围住的小水塘只剩几十条鱼，研究者发现一种并不带来优势的斑纹在几代之内就再也找不到了。 In a small isolated pond, genetic drift removed a neutral colour variant within a few generations.
sceneCN: 这里指随机漂变这一机制（第 1 个义项：小种群中因抽样误差而发生的等位基因频率随机变动）；句意为在一个小而隔离的池塘里，漂变在几代之内就让一个中性色斑变异消失了。图中可辨识物件：水塘、鱼群、斑纹、岩石围岸。

pos.zh: 名词短语：不可数，指一种演化机制；可加定冠词或修饰语

derivatives.zh: 同一词根独立成词，义为「漂移；漂流」，在遗传学中引申为频率的随机游走
由动词转作名词，义为「缓慢的移动；趋势」，是本短语的中心词
由中心词加进行式词尾构成，义为「漂移的；漂流的」
由中心词与「木材」复合，义为「浮木」，字面即被水推着走的木头
由中心词与「网」复合，义为「流网」，指随水流漂移的渔网

senses.title: The mechanism itself
senses.definition: random fluctuation of allele frequencies caused by the sampling of gametes in each generation
senses.definitionCN: 每一代配子抽样所造成的等位基因频率随机波动
senses.example: Genetic drift can change a neutral variant's frequency without any change in fitness.
senses.exampleCN: 遗传漂变可以在适应度毫无变化的情况下改变一个中性变异的频率。
senses.why: Not every individual reproduces, so each generation inherits a sample rather than the whole pool; sampling always wobbles, and the wobble is the mechanism.
senses.whyCN: 并非每个个体都留下后代，因此每一代继承的只是一个样本而非全部基因库；抽样必然抖动，这种抖动就是机制本身。

senses.title: Sampling error, not fitness
senses.definition: the statistical error that arises because a finite number of offspring is drawn from a larger pool
senses.definitionCN: 从较大基因库中只抽取有限数量后代时产生的统计误差
senses.example: The allele spread through genetic drift, by sampling error rather than because it helped its carriers.
senses.exampleCN: 这个等位基因扩散开来是抽样误差所致，而不是因为它对携带者有利。
senses.why: In a finite population the next generation is a random draw; any draw can depart from the parental proportions, and the departure needs no advantage.
senses.whyCN: 在有限群体中，下一代是一次随机抽取；任何一次抽取都可能偏离亲代比例，而这种偏离并不需要任何优势。

senses.title: Stronger in small populations
senses.definition: the smaller the effective number of breeders, the larger the random swings in frequency
senses.definitionCN: 参与繁殖的有效个体越少，频率的随机摆幅就越大
senses.example: Genetic drift in a handful of survivors can shift frequencies far more than a thousand breeders could.
senses.exampleCN: 少数幸存者能造成的频率偏移，远比上千个繁殖个体所能造成的更大。
senses.why: With few draws the law of large numbers stops protecting the population, so chance alone can push a variant to a high frequency.
senses.whyCN: 抽取次数很少时，大数定律不再保护群体，单靠偶然就能把某个变异推到很高的频率。

senses.title: Contrast with natural selection
senses.definition: change that is random with respect to fitness, unlike selection, which is directed by reproductive advantage
senses.definitionCN: 相对于适应度而言是随机的变化，不同于由繁殖优势定向的选择
senses.example: Selection favours the faster fish, while genetic drift ignores speed altogether.
senses.exampleCN: 选择偏爱游得更快的鱼，漂变则完全不看速度。
senses.why: Selection has a criterion; drift has none, so the two forces can push the same allele in opposite directions.
senses.whyCN: 选择有标准，漂变没有标准，因此两种力量可以把同一个等位基因推向相反方向。

senses.title: Contrast with gene flow
senses.definition: loss or fixation within a closed group, whereas gene flow brings alleles in from outside
senses.definitionCN: 在封闭群体内部的丢失或固定，而基因流从外部把等位基因带进来
senses.example: The island lost variation through genetic drift because no migrants reached it.
senses.exampleCN: 这座岛因为从未有迁入者到达，变异在漂变中流失。
senses.why: Drift reshuffles a closed gene pool; migration reopens it, so the two mechanisms pull diversity in opposite directions.
senses.whyCN: 漂变在一个封闭基因库里重新洗牌；迁移把它重新打开，两种机制因此把多样性往相反方向拉。

senses.title: Fixation and loss
senses.definition: the end points of drift, where one allele reaches a frequency of one and all others reach zero
senses.definitionCN: 漂变的两个终点：某个等位基因频率达到一，其他等位基因频率降到零
senses.example: After several bottlenecks, genetic drift fixed the rare allele in the whole herd.
senses.exampleCN: 经历数次瓶颈之后，那个稀有等位基因在整个兽群中被固定下来。
senses.why: A random walk in a bounded interval must eventually hit a boundary; in genetics the boundaries are one hundred percent and zero.
senses.whyCN: 有界区间内的随机游走终究会撞到边界；在遗传学里，边界就是一成与零。

senses.title: Population bottlenecks
senses.definition: a sharp temporary reduction in population size that lets drift erase much of the standing variation
senses.definitionCN: 种群规模的骤然暂时缩减，使漂变抹去大量既有变异
senses.example: A bottleneck during the drought let genetic drift cut the colony's diversity by half.
senses.exampleCN: 干旱期间的瓶颈使这个群体的多样性减少了一半。
senses.why: A crash keeps only a small sample of the old gene pool, and the survivors' proportions become the new baseline.
senses.whyCN: 崩溃只留下旧基因库的一小份样本，而幸存者的比例就成了新的基准。

senses.title: The founder effect
senses.definition: drift in a small group that leaves a parent population and carries only a fraction of its variation
senses.definitionCN: 一小群个体离开母群体时只带走一部分变异，由此产生的漂变
senses.example: Through the founder effect, genetic drift left the new colony with an allele absent from the mainland.
senses.exampleCN: 奠基者效应使新群体带有一个大陆群体根本没有的等位基因。
senses.why: A founding group is a sample taken once, so its quirks are frozen into the new population before drift even starts.
senses.whyCN: 奠基群体是一次性抽取的样本，它的偶然特征在漂变开始之前就已被冻结进新群体。

senses.title: Effective population size
senses.definition: the number of individuals that actually contribute genes, which is usually far below the census count
senses.definitionCN: 真正贡献基因的个体数目，通常远低于清点得到的个体数
senses.example: The effective population size was a tenth of the head count, so genetic drift acted far faster than expected.
senses.exampleCN: 有效种群规模只有清点头数的十分之一，因此漂变起作用的速度远超预期。
senses.why: Only breeders pass genes on, and unequal family sizes shrink the effective number further, so census size overstates the buffer against drift.
senses.whyCN: 只有繁殖者传递基因，而各家庭规模不均又进一步压低有效数目，所以清点规模会高估抵御漂变的缓冲。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Greek-derived technical adjective with an Old English noun of motion. The adjective dates from the naming of genetics in 1905; the noun's shift from physical drifting to statistical wandering happened in the twentieth century.
intro.cn: 这个短语由希腊词根的技术形容词与一个古英语动作名词组成。形容词随一九零五年遗传学的命名而定型；名词从物理漂移转向统计意义上的游走，则发生在二十世纪。

items.en: Genetikos meant concerned with generation, from genesis, origin; English genetics was coined from this root in 1905.
items.cn: 这个希腊形容词表示「与生育、发生有关的」，源于表示「起源」的名词；英语的遗传学之名即由此在一九零五年造出。

items.en: Drifan meant to drive or to push; the noun drift described the slow movement of a boat or of snow heaped by wind.
items.cn: 这个古英语动词意为驱动、推动；其名词形式先指船只的缓慢移动或被风堆积的雪。

items.en: By the fourteenth century drift covered anything carried along without steering, including cloud, sand and ships.
items.cn: 到十四世纪，这个词已涵盖一切无人操舵而被动带走之物，包括云、沙与船。

items.en: Sewall Wright described evolution by random drift in the late 1920s and 1930s, giving the old word a statistical meaning.
items.cn: 赖特在二十世纪二十年代末至三十年代描述了由随机漂变推动的演化，使这个旧词获得了统计含义。

items.en: The fixed phrase genetic drift spread in the middle of the twentieth century; its exact first appearance is not dated with certainty.
items.cn: 这个固定短语在二十世纪中叶流行开来；其确切首见时间并无确定记录。

note.en: The first group is built on the same noun or the same field; the second group names other forces that move allele frequencies.
note.cn: 第一组共享同一个中心词或同一领域；第二组是推动等位基因频率的其他力量。

entries.definition: The noun behind the phrase, meaning slow unsteered movement.
entries.definitionCN: 短语背后的名词，义为缓慢且无人操控的移动。

entries.definition: The body of models describing random frequency change.
entries.definitionCN: 描述频率随机变动的一套模型。

entries.definition: The loss of fitness caused by the accumulation of harmful variants through drift.
entries.definitionCN: 因漂变累积有害变异而造成的适应度损失。

entries.definition: The population size below which drift overwhelms weak selection.
entries.definitionCN: 漂变压过弱选择时的种群规模界限。

entries.definition: An older looser wording for the same mechanism.
entries.definitionCN: 同一机制的较早、较宽松说法。

entries.definition: Directed change in allele frequencies caused by differences in survival and reproduction.
entries.definitionCN: 由生存与繁殖差异造成的、有方向性的等位基因频率变化。

entries.definition: Movement of alleles between populations through migration or dispersal.
entries.definitionCN: 通过迁移或扩散在群体之间发生的等位基因流动。

entries.definition: A special case of drift set off by a small founding group.
entries.definitionCN: 由小型奠基群体引发的一种特殊漂变。

entries.definition: A special case of drift set off by a sharp population crash.
entries.definitionCN: 由种群骤减引发的一种特殊漂变。

entries.definition: The statistical deviation that drift turns into an evolutionary force.
entries.definitionCN: 漂变转化为演化力量的那个统计偏差。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations follow the sampling picture; abstract ones treat drift as a coin walk with no judge.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想沿着抽样图景展开；抽象联想把漂变看作一场没有裁判的硬币游走。

normal.en: Drift is what happens when nobody is choosing: the survivors are simply whoever happened to breed.
normal.cn: 漂变就是无人挑选时发生的事：幸存者只是碰巧留下后代的那一批。

normal.en: The smaller the pond, the bigger the wobble; a few fish can rewrite the proportions.
normal.cn: 水塘越小，摆幅越大；几条鱼就能改写整个比例。

normal.en: Bottlenecks and founder events are drift given a dramatic entrance.
normal.cn: 瓶颈与奠基者事件，是漂变有了戏剧性的登场方式。

normal.en: Fixation is the end of the walk: one variant at one hundred percent, all the others at zero.
normal.cn: 固定是这次游走的终点：一个变异达到一成，其余全部归零。

normal.en: Effective population size, not the head count, tells drift how much room it has.
normal.cn: 决定漂变空间的是有效种群规模，而不是清点人数。

abstract.en: Drift is a coin tossed by survivors, and no one is keeping score of fitness.
abstract.cn: 漂变是幸存者抛出的硬币，没有人替适应度记账。

abstract.en: Randomness needs no reason; it only needs a small enough room.
abstract.cn: 随机不需要理由，只需要一个足够小的空间。

abstract.en: In a closed room, diversity leaks away one accidental generation at a time.
abstract.cn: 在封闭的房间里，多样性会随着一个个偶然的世代慢慢漏光。

examples.en: Genetic drift can fix a harmful allele in a small herd.
examples.cn: 遗传漂变可能在一个小兽群中把有害等位基因固定下来。

examples.en: Island populations lose variation through genetic drift more quickly than mainland ones.
examples.cn: 岛屿群体通过遗传漂变丢失变异的速度快于大陆群体。

examples.en: The model separates genetic drift from selection by switching fitness off.
examples.cn: 该模型通过关闭适应度，把遗传漂变与选择区分开来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「基因 追福特」——基因像被水流推着走，没人掌舵，方向全靠偶然：遗传漂变

root: 第一个成分是希腊语 genesis「起源」派生的形容词，一九零五年成为遗传学的名称；第二个成分来自古英语 drifan「驱动、推动」，名词本指船只或积雪的缓慢移动，二十世纪三十年代由赖特赋予统计含义。短语的确切首见年代不确定，两个成分的来源清楚。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses run from the bare mechanism through its statistical cause, its strength in small groups, its two contrasts, its end points, its two dramatic cases and its accounting unit.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项从机制本身出发，经过统计成因、在小群体中的强度、两组对比、两个终点、两种戏剧性情形，最后落到核算单位。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rock-walled pond where a harmless stripe quietly disappears.
core.cn: 核心意象：一口石围小塘，一种无害斑纹悄然消失。

branches.en: THE MECHANISM: a finite sample of gametes wobbles, and the wobble is drift.
branches.cn: 机制本身：有限的配子样本发生抖动，这种抖动就是漂变。

branches.en: THE SCALE EFFECT: few breeders mean wide swings, because large-number protection fails.
branches.cn: 规模效应：繁殖者少则摆幅大，因为大数保护失效。

branches.en: THE TWO CONTRASTS: selection has a criterion, migration reopens the pool, drift has neither.
branches.cn: 两组对比：选择有标准，迁移能重新打开基因库，而漂变两者皆无。

branches.en: THE END POINT AND ITS ACCOUNTING: the walk hits one or zero, and effective size sets how fast.
branches.cn: 终点与核算：游走撞到一或零，而有效规模决定撞得多快。

branches.en: THE DRAMATIC CASES: a crash or a small founding group compresses the whole process into a moment.
branches.cn: 戏剧性情形：一次崩溃或一个小奠基群，把整个过程压缩到一瞬间。

intro.en: Both halves of the phrase are whole words rather than affixes; the only bound pieces are the adjective ending and the noun's old verbal core.
intro.cn: 短语两半都是完整的词而非词缀；真正的黏着成分只有形容词词尾与名词古老的动词核心。

latinIntro.en: Greek supplies the root of generation; Old English supplies the verb of driving. No Latin noun stands behind the phrase, so the Latin entry list is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语提供了「生成」的词根；古英语提供了「驱动」的动词。短语背后没有拉丁名词，因此拉丁词条列表留空。

items.exampleCN: 它把希腊词根挂到英语形容词上。

items.example: The verb describes a force moving something along.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词描述把某物推着走的力量。

items.meaningCN: 缓慢且无人操控的移动
items.example: The noun moved from boats and snow to allele frequencies.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词从船只与积雪转到等位基因频率。

items.example: The verb keeps the passive image behind the statistical term.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词保留了统计术语背后的被动意象。

items.example: It turns the verb of driving into a noun of motion.
items.exampleCN: 它把表示驱动的动词变成表示运动的名词。

definition_zh: 人口下降；（生物）种群下降
definition_en: a fall in the number of people or organisms in a place or group
core_image: 一间村校的窗户一扇扇钉上木板，操场上的草慢慢长高
scene: 这里指「人口下降」。 Population decline has closed schools across the rural county.
sceneCN: 这里 population decline 指「人口数量的持续减少」（第 1 个义项：某地居民总数下降）；句意为人口下降使这个农业县多所学校关停。图中可辨识物件：钉上木板的校窗、长草的操场、空荡的街道、逐年缩短的柱状图。

pos.zh: 人口下降；种群下降（不可数，指具体一次下降时偶作可数）

forms.label: 复数（少见，指多次局部下降）

senses.title: Fewer people in a place
senses.definition: a fall in the number of people living in a place
senses.definitionCN: 某地居住人数的下降
senses.example: Population decline has closed schools across the rural county.
senses.exampleCN: 人口下降使这个农业县多所学校关停。
senses.why: decline means to bend downward, so the phrase states that the count is going down rather than up.
senses.whyCN: decline 意为「向下弯」，因此这个短语陈述的是数目在向下走而非向上。

senses.title: Falling below replacement
senses.titleCN: 低于更替水平的长期下降
senses.definition: a sustained fall in births so that each generation is smaller than the one before
senses.definitionCN: 出生持续减少，使每一代都比上一代更小
senses.example: Population decline set in once births fell below two per woman.
senses.exampleCN: 出生数降到每名女性不足两个之后，人口下降开始出现。
senses.why: a population replaces itself only at about two births per woman, so a sustained fall below that line is decline built into the structure.
senses.whyCN: 人口只有在每名女性约生育两个时才能自我更替，长期低于这条线，下降就写进了结构。

senses.title: Loss through emigration
senses.definition: a fall caused by more people leaving than arriving
senses.definitionCN: 迁出多于迁入所造成的下降
senses.example: Population decline in the uplands followed the closure of the mines.
senses.exampleCN: 矿区关闭后，高地出现了人口下降。
senses.why: a place can lose people without any fall in births, simply because more leave than arrive.
senses.whyCN: 一个地方即使出生数没有下降，也会因迁出多于迁入而失去人口。

senses.title: A species losing numbers
senses.definition: a fall in the numbers of a wild species
senses.definitionCN: 野生种群数量的减少
senses.example: The survey recorded a steep population decline among the bees.
senses.exampleCN: 调查记录到蜜蜂数量的急剧下降。
senses.why: the phrase is not restricted to people, since a population in ecology is any countable group of organisms.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语并不限于人，因为生态学中的种群是任何可计数的生物群体。

senses.title: The measured rate of loss
senses.definition: the percentage by which numbers fall in a given period
senses.definitionCN: 一定时期内数量下降的百分比
senses.example: The population decline rate reached two percent a year.
senses.exampleCN: 人口下降速率达到每年百分之二。
senses.why: once the fall is measured against time, it can be compared with growth rates and with other places.
senses.whyCN: 一旦把下跌按时间计量，就能与增长率及其他地方比较。

senses.title: The economic consequence
senses.titleCN: 经济后果：需求与税基收缩
senses.definition: the shrinking of demand, tax base and services that follows fewer people
senses.definitionCN: 人口减少带来的需求、税基与服务收缩
senses.example: Population decline left the region with empty housing and fewer doctors.
senses.exampleCN: 人口下降让这个地区留下空置住房与更少的医生。
senses.why: fewer residents mean fewer customers, a smaller tax base and services that can no longer be staffed.
senses.whyCN: 居民减少意味着顾客减少、税基缩小，服务也再难配齐人员。

senses.title: A policy worry
senses.titleCN: 政策议题：下降与老龄化
senses.definition: the framing of falling numbers as a problem for pensions and defence
senses.definitionCN: 把数量下降框定为养老金与国防问题
senses.example: The white paper treats population decline as a planning risk.
senses.exampleCN: 这份白皮书把人口下降视为规划风险。
senses.why: governments reframe a demographic fact as a risk to pensions and defence, which is how the phrase enters policy.
senses.whyCN: 政府把一个人口事实重新框定为养老金与国防风险，这个短语便由此进入政策。

senses.title: A sharp crash
senses.titleCN: 剧降：短时间内的崩溃式下跌
senses.definition: a sudden and severe drop in numbers, as after a disaster
senses.definitionCN: 数量在灾难等之后出现的骤然大幅下跌
senses.example: The population decline after the eruption was near total.
senses.exampleCN: 火山喷发之后，种群下降几乎是彻底的。
senses.why: the same noun covers the extreme case, where decline becomes a crash rather than a slow trend.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词也涵盖极端情形：下降成为崩溃，而非缓慢趋势。

intro.en: Population is Latin populus through populatio; decline comes from Latin declinare, de- 'down' plus clinare 'to bend'. The phrase is modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: population 经 populatio 来自拉丁 populus；decline 来自拉丁 declinare，由 de-「向下」与 clinare「弯」构成。这个短语是近代组合。年代均为约数。

items.en: Clinare meant 'to bend, lean', related to Greek klinein 'to lean'; the family also gives incline and recline.
items.cn: clinare 意为「弯、倾」，与希腊 klinein「倾靠」相关；同一词族还给出 incline 与 recline。

items.en: De- 'down' plus clinare gave declinare 'to bend away, turn aside', and figuratively to fall off or worsen.
items.cn: de-「向下」加 clinare 得 declinare「弯开、转向一旁」，比喻义为衰退、变坏。

items.en: English took decline in the fourteenth century, both as a verb of bending away and as a noun of worsening.
items.cn: 英语在 14 世纪吸收 decline，既作「偏离、弯开」的动词，也作「变坏」的名词。

items.en: The fixed phrase population decline spread in the twentieth century, as censuses made decades comparable and rural losses visible.
items.cn: 固定短语 population decline 在 20 世纪扩散，人口普查使跨年代比较与农村流失变得可见。

items.en: Late twentieth-century debates over ageing societies made the phrase a standard term in economics and planning.
items.cn: 20 世纪后期关于老龄化社会的辩论，使这个短语成为经济学与规划的标准术语。

items.en: Source uncertain (first dates): the earliest use of the exact phrase is not precisely recorded, and the deeper origin of clinare is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：这一确切短语的最早使用没有精确记录；clinare 的更深来源属重构形式。

note.en: Group one holds words of the clinare family that look alike; group two holds terms for numbers falling.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 clinare 词族、外形相近的词；第二组是表示数量下降的其他说法。

entries.definition: The verb and noun of going down; it also means to refuse politely, a sense the compound never carries.
entries.definitionCN: 指下降的动词与名词；另有礼貌拒绝义，而这一组合从不带该义。

entries.definition: In- 'toward' plus clinare: to lean or to tend toward something, the opposite direction of motion.
entries.definitionCN: in-「朝向」加 clinare：向某物倾斜或倾向于，方向相反。

entries.definition: Re- 'back' plus clinare: to lean backward, as a seat does. Nothing is falling in number.
entries.definitionCN: re-「向后」加 clinare：向后靠，如座椅后仰。与数量下降无关。

entries.definition: A downward angle, as of a magnetic needle; it is a technical measurement, not a fall in population.
entries.definitionCN: 指下倾角，如磁针的偏角；是技术度量，不是人口下降。

entries.definition: A neutral word for becoming less; it lacks the sense of a sustained trend that decline carries.
entries.definitionCN: 指变少的中性词；不像 decline 那样含持续趋势之意。

entries.definition: The process of a place losing its people; it is the human half of population decline.
entries.definitionCN: 指某地失去人口的过程；是人口下降的人的那一半。

entries.definition: A reduction in physical size or amount; it suits economies and garments as much as populations.
entries.definitionCN: 指体积或数量的缩小；可用于经济、衣物，也可用于人口。

entries.definition: A sudden fall or breakdown; it is the extreme case of decline, not the ordinary one.
entries.definitionCN: 指骤然下跌或崩溃；是下降的极端情形，而非通常情形。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: population 'count' + decline 'bend down': the count bending downward.
normal.cn: population「计数」+ decline「向下弯」：数目向下弯。

normal.en: The family runs decline, declining, declination, population, depopulation.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 decline、declining、declination、population、depopulation。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the senses: rural population decline, population decline rate, halt population decline.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出各义项：农村人口下降、人口下降速率、遏止人口下降。

normal.en: The verb decline also means to refuse; the noun in this phrase never does.
normal.cn: 动词 decline 也可指拒绝；但这个短语里的名词从不表示拒绝。

normal.en: The same bend appears in incline and recline, pointing other ways.
normal.cn: 同一个「弯」也出现在 incline 与 recline 中，方向不同。

abstract.en: Picture a school with boards over every window.
abstract.cn: 想象一所每扇窗都钉上木板的学校。

abstract.en: Picture a bar chart where each year is shorter than the last.
abstract.cn: 想象一张柱状图，每根柱子都比前一年短。

abstract.en: Picture a village where the only sound is grass growing.
abstract.cn: 想象一个村子，唯一的声响是草在长。

examples.en: Population decline has emptied half the apartments in the town.
examples.cn: 人口下降使镇上一半公寓空置。

examples.en: The report links population decline to a falling birth rate.
examples.cn: 报告把人口下降与出生率下滑联系起来。

examples.en: Fish population decline followed the loss of the shallows.
examples.cn: 浅滩消失之后，鱼群数量出现下降。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「population（人口）+ decline（向下弯）」——数目一路向下 → 人口下降

root: 拉丁 populus「人民」（来源不确定）+ populatio「人群」+ 拉丁 declinare「弯开、下倾」= de-「向下」+ clinare「弯」；英语 population decline。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one movement: a count bends downward, and that bend is then read as a birth shortfall, an emigration drain, a wildlife loss, a rate, an economic squeeze, a policy problem and a crash.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：某个计数向下弯，这个弯再被读成出生不足、迁出流失、野生种群减少、速率、经济收缩、政策难题与崩溃。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a village school boarded up while the grass grows in the yard.
core.cn: 核心意象：村校钉上木板，操场上的草在长。

branches.en: FALL AND RATE: the bare drop, then the same drop expressed per year.
branches.cn: 下降与速率：先是单纯下跌，再是换算成每年的同一跌幅。

branches.en: TWO DRAINS: too few births, or too many departures.
branches.cn: 两个流失口：出生太少，或离开太多。

branches.en: NON-HUMAN LOSS: bees and fish decline by the same grammar.
branches.cn: 非人类的减少：蜜蜂与鱼用同一套说法下降。

branches.en: CONSEQUENCES AND POLICY: empty housing and strained pensions follow the numbers.
branches.cn: 后果与政策：空置住房与吃紧的养老金随数字而来。

branches.en: CRASH: decline pushed to its extreme after a disaster.
branches.cn: 崩溃：灾难之后下降被推到极端。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Latin noun of people to a Latin verb-turned-noun of bending down; de- and -are are visible across the declinare family.
intro.cn: 这个短语把表示人民的拉丁名词与表示「向下弯」的拉丁动名词并置；de- 与 -are 在 declinare 词族中都看得见。

latinIntro.en: Latin declinare gives decline, declination, incline and recline; populus gives population and depopulation.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 declinare 衍生 decline、declination、incline 与 recline；populus 衍生 population 与 depopulation。

items.example: The prefix marks a downward motion.
items.exampleCN: 前缀标记向下的动作。

items.example: The root supplies the bending image.
items.exampleCN: 词根提供「弯」的意象。

items.example: Sales declined after midsummer.
items.exampleCN: 仲夏之后销量下滑。

items.exampleCN: 衰退中的镇子会失去公交线路。

items.example: The needle's declination was measured.
items.exampleCN: 磁针的偏角被测量了。

items.example: Population fell for a third year.
items.exampleCN: 人口连续第三年下降。

items.meaning: the loss of people from a place

items.exampleCN: 人口流失使高地农场空置。

definition_zh: 国内市场；本国市场；国内需求与交易环境
definition_en: the market inside one's own country, as opposed to markets abroad
core_image: 一间屋子的院墙之内摆着自己的摊位，墙外才是别人的集市，墙内的买卖自成一套价格
scene: 公司年会上，销售主管指着地图上本国的一整片区域，说明年的增长主要靠这里的买家。 The firm expects its domestic market to grow before it expands abroad.
sceneCN: 这里指「本国范围内的市场」，对应第 1 个义项：在一国边界之内进行的买卖与需求；句意为公司预计先在国内市场取得增长，再向海外扩张。画面要点：本国地图、院墙、店内摊位、增长曲线。
